name: Melanholia
source:
A short sad novel about depression. Story tells us about a high schooler who thinks there's something wrong with them. They get sent to therapy, doctor knows what they should do.

[From [url=https://nirexd.itch.io/melanholia]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部关于抑郁症的忧伤短篇视觉小说。故事讲述了一名觉得自己心理出了问题的高中生被送去接受心理治疗，而医生深知他们究竟该怎么做。

[摘自[url=https://nirexd.itch.io/melanholia]itch.io[/url]]
